examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A title, a description, and an inline "Undo" action — raised with a single `toast()` call.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Button from '@aziontech/webkit/button'
  import { toast, Toaster } from '@aziontech/webkit/toast'

  const show = () =>
    toast('Event has been created', {
      description: 'Sunday, December 03, 2023 at 9:00 AM',
      action: { label: 'Undo', onClick: () => {} }
    })
</script>

<template>
  <Toaster position="bottom-right" />
  <Button
    label="Show toast"
    @click="show"
  />
</template>

examples.name: Types
examples.summary: Each type (default, success, info, warning, error, loading) with its own icon, as a two-line toast (title + timestamp) matching the Figma. Loading spins.

examples.name: WithDescription
examples.summary: A two-line body — a title plus a supporting `description` line — raised with a single `toast()` call.
